description: This file defines the CsvExporter class responsible for exporting board data to CSV format, including generating CSV content from board and card data, encoding text, and handling download links.

classes.name: CsvExporter
classes.description: A utility class for exporting board data as CSV files.

methods.name: exportTableCsv
methods.description: Exports the specified board and cards as a CSV file, optionally for a specific view.

methods.name: encodeText
methods.description: Encodes text for CSV compatibility by escaping quotes and replacing hash symbols.

methods.name: generateTableArray
methods.description: Generates a 2D array representing the CSV data, including headers and card properties.
